title: Add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Sofia Martinez
release_notes: Added RAG agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples across docs and examples repos; updated docs site nav and images. Backwards-compatible documentation-only change.
description: Motivation: Provide opinionated, runnable quickstarts for building RAG-based agents using Redwood's tool-calling primitives. Teams repeatedly ask for end-to-end examples (prompt templates, retrieval wiring, and tool-call handlers) that are small enough to skim but complete enough to run locally. This PR adds: 1) two new quickstarts for the docs site (Node/TypeScript and Python) showing RAG + agent tool-calling patterns; 2) a set of reusable RAG prompt templates and configuration examples under redwood-examples; 3) a simple tool-calling example demonstrating structured function responses and graceful fallbacks; 4) docs site sidebar and image updates. The description below summarizes changes, testing, and migration notes.

review_comments: Evan Cho (reviewer): Nice set of quickstarts. Can we add a short note about required env vars (REDWOOD_API_KEY, VECTOR_DB_URL) at the top of each quickstart? Also please ensure the Node example has a package.json script to run the example.
Sofia Martinez (author): Added an env vars section and package.json script in the Node quickstart. I also added check instructions for local vector DB emulation (we use sqlite-backed example).
Priya Nair (reviewer): In tool-calling.md, clarify expected schema for function outputs (JSON schema example would help). Also flag the async/await streaming caveat for long-running tools.
Sofia Martinez (author): Included a small JSON schema snippet and a paragraph about streaming fallbacks. Ran the examples locally and added a short troubleshooting section.
Liam O'Connor (approver): Verified the docs build and smoke tests on a fresh VM. Examples run end-to-end. Approving — minor nits fixed in follow-up.
CI Bot: All checks passed (docs build, lint, examples-smoke-tests).
ci_summary: examples-smoke-tests: pass (runs quickstarts in CI matrix)
testing_and_validation: Ran docs site build locally (next.js static export) and confirmed new quickstarts render and link from sidebar. Executed Node and Python quickstarts against a local sqlite retriever + Redwood hosted API sandbox; validated tool-calling flow and structured function JSON responses. Added a CI smoke test matrix that executes a headless run of both quickstarts to prevent regressions.
migration_notes: Docs-only change and examples; no runtime behavior modified. Consumers can adopt the quickstarts without code migrations. If teams copy the retriever helper, they should replace the example vector DB with their production store and rotate API keys.
merge_outcome: Merged into main via squash after approvals from reviewers. All CI checks passed and smoke tests validated examples.
security_considerations: Examples include a clear 'do not commit secrets' note and the quickstarts recommend using Redwood's ephemeral sandbox API keys for testing. No new secrets or credentials stored in the repo. Added audit note for future private deployment examples.
